# Leave Policy — India

Employees in the India office are entitled to 18 Earned Leave (EL) days, 12 Casual Leave (CL)
days, and 12 Sick Leave (SL) days per calendar year.

EL can be carried forward up to 45 days accumulated; CL and SL do not carry forward and reset
each January 1.

Leave requests go through the Darwinbox portal, approved by your direct manager within 2 business
days. National holidays (as per the Maharashtra state holiday list) are separate from EL/CL/SL.

Contact hr-india@alderbrooksystems.example with questions.
